content: Our data has been developed by crawling and pre-processing an OSG web forum. The forum has a great variety of different groups such as depression, anxiety, stress, relationship, cancer, sexually transmitted diseases, etc. Each conversation starts with one post and can contain multiple comments. Each post or comment is represented by a poster, a timestamp, a list of users it is referencing to, thread id, a comment id and a conversation id. The thread id is the same for comments replying to each other, otherwise it is different. The thread id is increasing with time. Thus, it provides ordering among threads; whereas the timestamp provides ordering in the thread.
